overview_description.description: Zeplin is an organized workspace to publish finalized designs, where the entire team can collaborate to ship beautiful products together. The company supports 5+ million users from thousands of product teams including Apple, Starbucks, Salesforce, Amazon, Microsoft, Audi, and many more. Zeplin is a Y Combinator startup, also backed by amazing investors like Elad Gil, Mike Maples, and Kevin Hale.

about_short_description.short_description: Zeplin is a collaboration tool between designers and developers to publish finalized designs

product.name: Zeplin Design Delivery Platform
product.description: A platform that publishes finalized designs to facilitate collaboration between designers and developers, providing a centralized workspace for design handoff and documentation.

product.name: Omlet Component Analytics
product.description: A tool for developers to analyze and track usage and performance of design components within projects.

product.name: Design System Sync and Export
product.description: A feature that exports design tokens and syncs components and styles from design tools to code in multiple programming languages.

product.name: User Flows and Documentation
product.description: Tools to map user journeys, document design intent, and annotate designs with requirements and behaviors for team collaboration.

product.name: Integrations and Workflow Automation
product.description: Integrations with design, development, and collaboration tools to automate workflows and connect design delivery with existing tech stacks.
